A redeploy of a Stable, given-up or operator-stopped service reports the recorded verdict at once; a superseded attempt's give-up is never reported

steps.name: Guest listen hooks with real-boot proof
criteria: Real-boot Tier-3 tests on native metal (kvm-tests) show a TCP and a UDP declared listener reach a Pass startup probe row through the guest's LISTEN lines
G-10 item 9: init's own pre-READY binds produce zero LISTEN lines; item 10: loopback-only and v4-mapped binds are handled as pinned, both observed via the startup probe row
Drain before EXIT, one ordered beacon writer, workload created atomically in the workload cgroup; root programs stay ALLOW_MULTI link attachments
overdrive serve plus overdrive deploy of a never-listening Service stops, restarts and gives up StartupProbeFailed on metal
steps.test_file: crates/overdrive-cli/tests/integration (Tier-3 real-boot tests not yet authored; acceptance-designer authors them before this step starts)
steps.implementation_notes: Decision: D13 guest side (PR-2, V34-V36, V38, V41, V42, ADR-0272/0268). Behaviour pinned in feature-delta D13 item 1: init creates ONE workload cgroup before READY, attaches a separate small sockops TCP_LISTEN_CB program (same object, P-a: no second Ebpf::load) and two CgroupSock post-bind4/post-bind6 programs to it, and starts the workload directly in it (P-c: CLONE_INTO_CGROUP; clone3 replaces Command::spawn, crafter pins exit-127 versus InitError::Spawn); existing root programs stay BPF_F_ALLOW_MULTI link attachments (P-b); loopback-only binds are not reported; every distinct (protocol, port) is sent as exactly one LISTEN line; one ordered beacon writer (overdrive-init::send &mut File, no forwarder thread) and drain the listen ring before EXIT. eBPF is aya-rs Rust, never C (spike.md). New program files and the forwarding structure are the crafter's (internal). TIER-3 OBLIGATION (DG-8, ruled 2026-11-05): no pre-authored test exists for G-10 items (9) and (10) or the guest half of guest_report. Test authoring belongs to the acceptance designer: the orchestrator MUST route authoring of these real-boot tests (ignored with `pending DELIVER: D13 guest side`) to nw-acceptance-designer BEFORE dispatching this step, and the crafter does not author them. They run on native x86_64 metal with the `kvm-tests` feature via `cargo xtask metal run -- cargo nextest run -p <crate> --features integration-tests,kvm-tests`, never Lima, and observe through the startup probe row. Spike evidence stays V34 to V36, V42 (spike/ findings). Scaffolds owned: none.
